title: Sabine — Alleinstehende deutsche Frau, volle Erwerbsminderungsrente
scenario: Mid-flow, deliberately incomplete. Her Rentenbescheid is missing entirely and her Kontoauszug is flagged as an old statement — the exact 'unclear or hard-to-obtain proof' situation her User Story 6 describes. Use this one for to-do handling, encouragement copy, and the cognitive-load questions.

profile.reduced_work_capacity_reason: Unbefristete volle Erwerbsminderung, festgestellt durch den Rentenversicherungsträger

documents.internal_error_log: Demo fixture: statement period ends more than three months before the application date.

missing_documents.note: THE point of this persona. Her Rentenbescheid is old, she is unsure whether it is even needed, and she cannot find it — her User Story 6. Do not add it; add the to-do UX around it instead.
Gaszentralheizung — a Heizkostenabrechnung from the Wohnungsbaugesellschaft would fit.
Vermögenserklärung — she has none, so a nil declaration.
SGB II instrument; not part of an SGB XII application.

research.core_barrier: Fear and overwhelm from long, complex applications. Cognitive limitations mean she needs support with difficult questions, and stress further reduces her concentration. A calming entry point is what reduces her drop-off risk.
research.usage_context: Supported self-service: normally at a PC or terminal in a counselling setting (Caritas, hospital, Sozialamt) together with a professional — not alone at home on a phone. Co-use is the core case, and she must stay in control while it happens.
key_wishes: Small steps with a clear structure and no overwhelm
Reassurance and expectation-setting at the start (duration, steps, what is needed)
Encouragement and confirmation — 'everything done correctly', 'almost done'
Specific document instructions per section (what exactly, which period)
Help with unclear or old proofs, including how to request them
A 'filling out together' mode that does not take control away from her
Understanding the monthly deadline logic and being able to submit on time even when incomplete
key_fears: Entering something incorrectly and being disadvantaged or delayed for it
The sheer scope — 'no less than 80 pages if everything is included'
Not knowing which documents are really necessary, e.g. a pension notice from years ago
Hesitation to ask what she fears are 'silly questions'

not_representable.note: There are no insurance-cost columns, so the €120 is recorded only in the stmt3 document's `amount_liability_insurance`. 'Living alone but in a relationship' has no representation — `marital_status: Single` with a 1-person household is the closest fit. Cognitive support needs are deliberately NOT stored: they are research context, and Art. 9 GDPR data has no business in this table. Both gaps are filed.

unreconciled.need_and_entitlement: Stated gross need approx. €1,120 excluding housing costs, with net entitlement €860–890, alongside a €780 Warmmiete and a note that recognised housing costs typically run €400–500. The €1,120 is only consistent with a recognised (appropriateness-capped) housing cost well below her actual rent. Recorded as stated.
unreconciled.age: Stated as a 50–65 range; born 1968 here, so 58.

research.notes: The missing pension_notice is intentional and is the point of this persona — it is the concrete instance of the 'I do not know whether I need the old Rentenbescheid, and I cannot find it' problem. Do not 'fix' it by adding the document.
